inherited_options.base_model: posterior physics mean + sequential stationary ST
inherited_options.current_observation_protocol: fixed-stride unsaturated plus every observed-censored pixel
inherited_options.calibration_target: known reference-camera measurement in deliberately hidden band
inherited_options.models: {"A": "Current-only ambient mean + RBF", "B": "Posterior physics mean + RBF", "C": "Posterior physics mean + sequential stationary ST"}

execution_order: Both reference cases first; higher ceilings only if both pass reliability/runtime

arms.legacy_hybrid: Cached sparse censored GP plus all unsaturated noisy values pinned
arms.correlation_control: Output59 joint residual correction on censored block, same cached mean
arms.all_readings_pinned: Condition censored GP on ALL unsaturated readings, then pin unsaturated latent values
arms.all_readings_latent: SAME all-readings posterior as pinned bridge; retain full latent covariance and mean

matched_information: All arms use the same camera values somewhere; likelihood use differs in the bridge, explicitly
latent_covariance: Analytic C=vI-v^2P; no independent residual approximation in propagation
seed_rule: Inherited previous_seed + 10000*chain + 1000003; retry uses same chain seeds
truth_use: Evaluation and fixed evaluation regions only; inherited simulator-derived preparation retained
